condition: A Series with ArrowDtype(pa.string_view()/binary_view()) that has missing values shows an empty repr, and to_string/to_numpy fail with ArrowNotImplementedError because pyarrow has no filter kernel for view types.
workaround: Cast to pa.string()/pa.large_string() instead of string_view before building the pandas Series, or patch ArrowDtype.type to return str for string_view.
